Name: Roodle's Vocaloid Merchandise for Content Patcher
Author: Roodle143
Description:
[size=4]This mod adds the following Vocaloids/synths as dolls for decoration:[/size][size=3] [color=#cc4125]Meiko[/color], [color=#3c78d8]Kaito[/color],[color=#a2c4c9] Hatsune Miku[/color], [color=#ffd966]Kagamine [/color][color=#ffe599]Rin [/color][color=#ffd966]&[/color] [color=#f1c232]Len[/color], [color=#f4cccc]Megurine Luka[/color], [color=#93c47d]Gumi[/color], [color=#e06666]Kasane Teto[/color], [color=#e06666]Kasane Teto SynthV[/color], [size=3][color=#8e7cc3]Gakupo[/color], [color=#d8d8d8]Yowane Haku[/color],[color=#d5a6bd] Momone Momo[/color], [color=#ffd966]Akita Neru[/color],[color=#ead1dc] Sakura Miku[/color], [color=#d0e0e3]Snow Miku[/color], and [color=#b4a7d6]Utane Uta[/color][/size].

[/size][size=4][b]New[/b][/size][size=3]: Flower, Fukase, IA, Nekomura Iroha, SeeU, Luo Tianyi, and Otomachi Una

The dolls are added as new furniture that you can get either through the furniture catalogue or buying from Robin's shop on Mondays for 100g.

Their design inspirations are: Meiko V3, Kaito V3, Miku V2, Rin & Len V2 act2, Luka V3, Gumi V2, Teto UTAU and SynthV, [size=3]Gackpoid Native V3, Haku's standard, Momo's stanard, Neru's standard, Sakura Miku's standard, Snow Miku's original design, and Uta's standard.[/size]
[/size][size=4][b]New:[/b][/size][size=3] v4 flower, standard Fukase, standard IA, Iroha V4 Natural, standard SeeU, Tianyi V3, and Una V4 Sugar.

[size=3][b]
Required mods:[/b] SMAPI, Content Patcher, and SpaceCore.


[/size][/size][font=Courier New][size=5][b]Installation: [/b][/size][/font][size=3][size=3]
You will need SMAPI and Content Patcher for this mod, when you've
downloaded the mod just drop it into your mods folder at
(Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods).
You will need to have SpaceCore if you want unique item descriptions.
[/size]
I am a novice modder so if there are any issues please let me know and I'll do my best to fix it!

[/size][size=5]Other:[/size][size=3]
I am thinking of adding more dolls so stay tuned! I am also thinking of adding other kinds of merch. If anyone has any suggestions feel free!
[/size]
